title.narrative: Emergency aid to support the conflict affected population in Ituri province (NEXUS project)

description.narrative: DRC is experiencing a worrying humanitarian situation which is reflected in the Humanitarian response plan for the DRC for the Year 2021 and Humanitarian Needs Overview 2022. The displaced population and the host families who have welcomed the displaced people and now are also experiencing pressure on their livelihoods. The project intends to provide rapid and timely relief in the sectors of 1) food and nutrition security, 2) access to basic WASH services and 3) other needs. The main objective of this intervention is to provide rapid relief to Internally Displaced Persons (IDP) who have lost their goods and livelihoods due to the persistent crisis in Ituri province of the DRC.

Project outcome : The living conditions of the conflict-affected population are improved through increased and ameliorated access to food, clean water and basic necessities as well as enhanced nutrition, hygiene and sanitation.Impact :Address immediate and basic needs of crisis affected people in Eastern Congo

The total number of direct beneficiaries targeted by the project is 10,400 households(HHs) (62,499 individuals) broken down as follows:Internally Displaces Persons: 6,240 HHs (37,440 individuals)Host families: 4,160 HHs (24,960 individuals)
